items.source:
Obtaining a PersistenceUnitInfo instance is an exclusive process.
A PersistenceUnitInfo instance is not available for further calls
anymore once it has been obtained.
items.translation: 获取 PersistenceUnitInfo 实例是一个独占过程。一旦获取了 PersistenceUnitInfo 实例，它便不再可用于后续的调用。

items.source: Obtain the default PersistenceUnitInfo from this manager.
items.translation: 从此管理器获取默认的 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source: Obtain the specified PersistenceUnitInfo from this manager.
items.translation: 从此管理器获取指定的 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if there is no default PersistenceUnitInfo defined or it has already been obtained
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果未定义默认的 PersistenceUnitInfo，或者它已经获取

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if no PersistenceUnitInfo with the given name is defined
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果未定义具有给定名称的 PersistenceUnitInfo

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the PersistenceUnitInfo with the given name has already been obtained
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果已获取具有给定名称的 PersistenceUnitInfo

items.source: persistenceUnitName - the name of the desired persistence unit
items.translation: - 所需持久化单元的名称
